about_the_game:
Corner Bookshop
A Magical Journey into the World of Picture Books

Step into Corner Bookshop, where picture books come to life and stories await in every corner. In collaboration with Dreaming Kite Corp., this virtual bookshop brings Dreaming Kite’s inspiring picture books vividly to life.

🌵 Discover Hidden Adventures in "The Farmer of the Desert"
Uncover the hidden key in "The Farmer of the Desert," one of the bookshop’s signature stories. Enter its pages, solve puzzles, and immerse yourself in breathtaking desert landscapes and captivating missions.

📚 A Collection of 20 Inspiring Picture Books
From books that help you rediscover dreams to comforting reads for a tired heart, and even those perfect for sharing with children—this curated collection of 20 picture books will resonate with everyone. Experience unique stories that inspire imagination and bring comfort.

✨ Join the Lovable Librarian Toto
Meet Toto, the charming librarian who works at the bookshop. Build a bond with Toto as you uncover hidden secrets together and enjoy heartwarming storytelling. Toto also offers personalized book recommendations, enriching your journey.

🌟 Key Features
• Interactive Picture Book Experiences
Enjoy beautifully animated books featuring whales, elephants, and more in a unique blend of art and storytelling.
• Mini-Games Inspired by Stories
Dive into books like "The Farmer of the Desert," solving puzzles, exploring fantasy worlds, and uncovering secrets.
• Connect with Toto
Engage in meaningful conversations with Toto and receive personalized book suggestions to enhance your adventure.
• Discover Secrets with Interactive Props
Watch animations with a projector or find inspiring messages and quotes in the mailbox.
• Test Your Literary Knowledge
Prove your love for literature with fun quizzes and unlock exclusive in-game items and collectibles.

📖 More Than Just a Game
Corner Bookshop is not just a game—it’s an immersive journey into a world of art, culture, and emotions. Experience the magic of picture books in a whole new way.

Available Now on Steam!

📢 Important Notes Before You Begin
Out of the 20 picture books, 18 are edited in English, while the remaining 2 include subtitles. For Japanese picture books, the main content is presented with subtitles, except for the cover. If you have ideas or feedback while reading the picture books, please share them in the comments. Your valuable input will help us improve the game. We look forward to hearing from you!

The Early Access version includes all the core gameplay features outlined in the "About This" section. Players can experience the fundamental game mechanics, interact with key characters, and progress through initial quests and areas. As development continues, we will expand content based on community feedback, improving gameplay balance and adding new features.

  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel CORE i5-12400F / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 660 or AMD R7 260x
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Realtak
